title: IDH adapter pilot evidence inventory
description: What one hand-ported skill slice actually proved on each harness, and how. Ticket 0802 owns this schema and its first entries; later slices append to the same arrays; ticket 0810 validates. Version support is a floor plus a probe, never an enumerated allowlist -- an allowlist revokes support on every upstream release.

canonical_sources.description: slice name -> the one live body, repo-relative.

minimum_version.description: Floor. A release above it is supported without editing this file.

probed_version.description: What the probe command actually returned on the pilot machine.

skills_root.description: The user-level directory this harness scans for skills.

source_concept.description: The thing being translated, named once in harness-neutral words.

native_expression.description: How this harness spells that concept.

disposition.description: shared: the same expression serves at least two harnesses. harness-specific: a one-off, deliberately left in its adapter. manual-only: no automated evidence is possible.

evidence_kind.description: local-probe: a real CLI answered, offline and with no model call, under both a negative and a positive control.

test.description: A pytest nodeid for static-test and local-probe; the procedure to run for manual-smoke; the citation for documentation.
